intro.speaker: WAREHOUSE
intro.text: Artifacts — the built versions of an application — are piling up in the warehouse. Someone tagged an unverified build latest and tried to send it to production. Ensure production only gets immutable, signed releases.

success.speaker: WAREHOUSE
success.text: Artifacts isolated. Production is now safe from untested or mutable binaries.

failure.speaker: WAREHOUSE
failure.text: A mutable or untrusted artifact leaked into the production lane. We have to rollback immediately.

rules: Separate immutable production artifacts from mutable development ones
Identify safe versioning and proven signatures

engineerMode.whatYouDid: You analyzed artifact metadata to ensure only semantically versioned and signed builds were permitted in production.
engineerMode.realWorld: In modern CI/CD, you should never deploy a mutable tag like 'latest'. Artifacts must be immutable (built once), cryptographically signed, and securely stored in an Artifact Registry before promotion.
engineerMode.artifact:
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
images:
  - name: my-app
    newTag: v1.4.2@sha256:8a13f...
